narrative_prose: Kaio burst into The Hearth, his boots leaving trails of glowing mud across the otherwise spotless deck plates as he clutching the heavily-insulated telemetry baton like a lifeline. The air was thick with the scent of simmering root-vegetable stew and the sharp metallic tang of the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea that had nearly battered him off the catwalks. He quickly moved to CONCEAL his muddy gear behind a heavy copper kettle, careful not to track more dirt, but his eyes lit up when he spotted a bubbling vat of broth that he just had to CONSUME a sample of to check its salinity. A sharp hiss of steam from the pressure cooker forced him to DEFEND his face with a raised forearm, laughing breathlessly as he finally spotted Ryn. Without preamble, he marched up and shoved the glowing baton firmly into Ryn's hands, a wide grin splitting his wind-chapped face.
